Package arztis.econnector.common.model

Class Card

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Card extends Object implements Serializable
This class includes all data, which can be extracted of e-Card or Admin-Card with GINO REST request.
